title: SABET-QA: Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2608.20083v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Question Answering over Temporal Knowledge Graphs (TKGQA) requires reasoning over time-sensitive facts, yet existing embedding-based methods struggle with multi-step queries due to single-pass reasoning pipelines. We propose SABET-QA, a framework that iteratively refines reasoning states across multiple hops via a bidirectional entity-temporal scoring mechanism and a slot-aware contextualization module that aligns question semantics with temporal KG embeddings. A differentiable working memory enables progressive hypothesis refinement, while auxiliary temporal boundaries serve as coarse supervision when available. Experiments on CronQuestions, Complex-CronQuestions, MultiTQ, and TimeQuestions demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines, particularly on complex multi-step temporal queries.

translated_abstract: 时序知识图谱上的问答（TKGQA）需要对时间敏感的事实进行推理，然而现有的基于嵌入的方法由于采用单次推理流程，在处理多步查询时面临困难。我们提出了SABET-QA框架，该框架通过双向实体-时间评分机制和槽位感知上下文模块，在多跳推理中迭代细化推理状态，并将问题语义与时序知识图谱嵌入对齐。可微工作记忆支持渐进式假设细化，同时辅助时间边界在可用时作为粗略监督。在CronQuestions、Complex-CronQuestions、MultiTQ和TimeQuestions上的实验表明，该方法在强基线上取得了一致的改进，尤其是在复杂的多步时序查询上。
tldr: 本文提出SABET-QA框架，通过双向实体-时间评分和槽位感知上下文模块，结合可微工作记忆进行迭代推理，显著提升了时序知识图谱上复杂多步问答的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SABET-QA, a framework that iteratively refines reasoning via bidirectional entity-temporal scoring and slot-aware contextualization with differentiable working memory, achieving consistent improvements on complex multi-step temporal KGQA tasks.
